
---
title: Hip and Knee Protheses
---

This instance both public and private data to study the patient pathways for hip and knee replacements surgeries[^1] .

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

import pandas as pd

# types_parcours_fields
types_parcours_fields = {
    "BEN_RES_DPT": "Patient department of residence",
    "sej_type": "Type of hospital stay (e.g., PTG, PTH)",
    "type_parcours": "Care pathway type",
    "SSR_TYPE": "Type of post-acute care (DOM, HC, HDJ, etc.)",
    "nb": "Number of patients"
}

# ssr_fields
ssr_fields = {
    "BOR": "Type of activity (SSR)",
    "AN": "Year",
    "FI": "Patient FINESS number",
    "FI_EJ": "Facility FINESS number",
    "GDE": "SSR group/type (e.g., SSR_A)",
    "AUT": "Other info",
    "LIT": "Number of beds",
    "PLA": "Number of places",
    "APEC": "Unknown (could be specialized activity)",
    "SEJHC": "Hospital days",
    "JOUHC": "Hospital stays",
    "SEJ3M": "3-month stays",
    "JOUHP": "Other hospital stay counts"
}

# mco_fields (shortened example; expand as needed)
mco_fields = {
    "BOR": "Activity type",
    "AN": "Year",
    "FI_EJ": "Legal FINESS ID / Facility identifier",
    "LIT_MED": "Beds (Medicine)",
    "JLI_MED": "Bed-days (Medicine)",
    "SEJHC_MED": "Full inpatient stays (Medicine)",
    "SEJ0_MED": "Day stays (Medicine)",
    "JOU_MED": "Hospital days (Medicine)"
    # ... you can continue adding the rest of your mco_fields entries here
}

# Convert to DataFrames
df_types_parcours = pd.DataFrame(list(types_parcours_fields.items()), columns=["Field", "Description"])
df_ssr = pd.DataFrame(list(ssr_fields.items()), columns=["Field", "Description"])
df_mco = pd.DataFrame(list(mco_fields.items()), columns=["Field", "Description"])

# Convert to HTML (wrap in div with max-width for Quarto HTML)
def html_table(df, max_width=500):
    html_table = df.to_html(index=False, border=1, justify="center")
    return f"""
<div style="max-width:{max_width}px; margin:auto;">
<style>
  table {{ width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: collapse; }}
  th, td {{ padding: 0.3em 0.5em; border: 1px solid #ccc; word-wrap: break-word; }}
</style>
{html_table}
</div>
"""

html_types_parcours = html_table(df_types_parcours)
html_ssr = html_table(df_ssr)
html_mco = html_table(df_mco)

from IPython.display import display, HTML
display(HTML(html_types_parcours))
display(HTML(html_ssr))
display(HTML(html_mco))

```

We can illustrate the general pathway of patients with the following graph:

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
```{mermaid}
graph TD
  A["CHIR/ORTHO (pre-op)"] --> B["ANESTH(pre-op)"]
  B --> C["Opt. Specialities"]
  C --> D["KINE_MCO (pre-op physiotherapy)"]
  D --> E["CHIR/ORTHO + ANESTH (surgery block)"]
  E --> F1["Scenario 0: DAY_HC / KINE_SSR / KINE_DOM = 28 / 0 / 0"]
  E --> F2["Scenario 1: DAY_HC / KINE_SSR / KINE_DOM = 0 / 0 / 25"]
  E --> F3["Scenario 2: DAY_HC / KINE_SSR / KINE_DOM = 21 / 20 / 0"]
  E --> F4["Scenario 3: DAY_HC / KINE_SSR / KINE_DOM = 0 / 25 / 0"]
  F1 --> G["CHIR/ORTHO (final post-op)"]
  F2 --> G
  F3 --> G
  F4 --> G
```
:::


[^1]:a footnote
